thread:
Maya (pm): Hey folks — we need to lock a cross-functional roadmap sync next week to resolve the priority gap between infra work and the new billing rollout. Can people propose 30-min slots?
Samir (eng): Tue 9–10am or Thu 3–4pm PT works for eng team.
Priya (eng-prod): Thu 3–4pm PT preferred for me (gives time after review meeting).
Leo (platform): Thu 3pm is :+1: for platform.
Jules (design): I can make Tue morning but Thu 3 is tight for design reviews — can we keep agenda tight?
Maya (pm): Good call. Agenda will be: 1) quick RFC review (billing v2), 2) infra capacity/quantization rollout, 3) decision capture + owners. Keep to 30 min.
Samir (eng): Suggest we do a 15-min pre-triage async thread to collect blockers so we don't go long.
Priya (eng-prod): I'll open an async checklist doc and tag owners. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/roadmap-prio-async (please add items).
ops-bot: Calendar poll created: https://redwood.internal/polls/1934567890 (votes open)
Maya (pm): Who will own the agenda and the decision log? Need a named owner to record decisions and follow-ups.
Leo (platform): I can capture infra decisions and follow-ups.
Jules (design): I can take design action items but prefer not to own the whole decision log.
Samir (eng): I'll own the main decision log during the meeting. I'll push entries to the decisions doc and tag assignees.
Priya (eng-prod): Thanks — can someone prep the RFC summary (1 slide) for billing v2?
Samir (eng): I'll prepare a 1-slide summary (impact, rollout risk, fallback plan).
Maya (pm): Perfect. Quick calendar invite template for whoever sends the invite (paste into event):
```
Title: Cross-functional Roadmap Sync — Priority Resolution
When: Thu 3:00–3:30 PM PT
Attendees: Product (Maya), Eng (Samir), Eng-Prod (Priya), Platform (Leo), Design (Jules)
Agenda: 1) RFC summary (5m) 2) Infra capacity/compat (10m) 3) Decision & owners (10m) 4) Wrap (5m)
Pre-reads: billing v2 RFC, infra capacity note (link in thread)
Owner (meeting notes): Samir
```
Priya (eng-prod): Also adding a tiny pre-read ask: everyone paste 2 bullet points for risks/rollback plan by EOD Wed.
Maya (pm): Added an agenda doc with section for decisions + action owners: https://redwood.internal/decisions/roadmap-2026-03 (Samir you'll have edit rights).
Samir (eng): Got edit rights. I'll start the decision table template: Decision | Rationale | Owner | Due | Follow-ups.
Jules (design): If we hit a priority dispute, can we use the tie-breaker rule (customer impact > internal infra) — remind folks at start.
Maya (pm): Will call that at the top.
Leo (platform): One more ask: if billing rollout needs specialized hardware, flag it in the pre-read. We need lead time for Dedicated capacity.
Priya (eng-prod): Noted. I'll add a capacity estimate.
ops-bot: Poll results: Thu 3pm wins (5 votes).
Maya (pm): OK booked Thu 3–3:30 PT. Samir — can you send invite with the template and attach the decision doc?
Samir (eng): Will send in 5.
Jules (design): Thanks — trying to keep design items short. If anything needs follow-up, we can spin out a focused design review.
Maya (pm): Great. If anyone wants to add an RFC to the agenda, add to the async checklist by EOD Wed so we can slot it.
Priya (eng-prod): Adding a note: please include expected SLO/latency targets when mentioning infra changes.
Samir (eng): Will include.
Maya (pm): Closing — invite should include links to RFC, pre-read checklist, and decisions doc. See you Thu. :calendar:
